text_block_list.text:
The Spring Tenno Sho. For Mejiro Ryan, the 
big showdown to prove her true strength 
had finally arrived.

And this race— is also the lifelong dream 
of my dear friend, Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Paddock entry will begin shortly... 
Warm-up is complete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The time is finally here, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because together, you and I have done 
all the preparation we possibly could.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen has bet her entire life on this 
3,200-meter race, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It will likely be a fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"They probably won't be coming today. 
There wasn't even a phone call yesterday."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Just a brief greeting in the paddock—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to run fair and square, and beat 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To me, fulfilling my long-cherished wish 
comes first. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I wish to win as well—against you, whom I 
respect so deeply.
